_about: H3 The seed in the ear. docs/archive/clinic/clinic-design-v1.md Q4 H3 and the quality pass Q1-Q7; contract docs/architecture/clinic-heal-api.md. Levels are data. The order row is decided by the real Kutchi pela ... ne poi ... with wadho/nindho (data/cook.json ids); the counts by the numbers. Level 1 carries the order (1 in 2) and two counts (1 in 3 each) so a blind bot stays under 10%. Things' names (seed, bead, sock) are English placeholders.

seed-in-ear.story: the cousin's ear, always something in it

fun: Each pull has its own noise (the sock squeaks); the patient giggles 'that tickles!'; the torch beam lights the cave; at the end the cousin shakes his head and hears again.

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
camera._target: A1 (5 Oct): the match cut. target = where the close-up draws the sore part and size = its radius, in the close-up's 800 x 500 units: the push-in ends with the patient's part (from the art's anchor) at that place and size.

art._about: heal-A, 2 Oct: the close-up art swaps in by file name (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md § 8). The code draws the stand-in until `on` is true; the cut session sets `on` once the file exists. box = where the picture sits, in the close-up's svg units (800 x 500).

ear._a1: A1 (5 Oct): E1's canal (822, 495 in the 1536 x 1024 source) on the game's canal (382, 268) at 0.97, the ear the stand-in's size (the wax spots, the sore skin and the drops keep their places); the head runs off the top, right and bottom.

bits._a1: A1 (5 Oct): O1's wax (drawn at 2.5 x the blob's radius, so the sizes keep their ratios) and the tissue; any patient.
bits._a2: A2 (5 Oct): O3's bud, clean and with wax (one canvas), the swab on the tip of the wipe

hearing._about: D15c (decision 27): the whispered-word check at the end of the ear. on: true (Zafar can switch it off here; the orchestrator recommends keeping it). words: lexicon ids in data/clinic/lang.json the child knows from Cook (their pictures are Cook's icons, assets/cook/items/icon-<id>.webp; family clips exist for limu, dungri and tameto; paani is stitched). choices: how many pictures per level. With it off, level 1's only Kutchi row is the drops count (25% blind).
